recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce CareTeam.context or CareTeam.encounter; the apparent mismatch with the 2017 wording is explained by later approved R5-era model changes and existing related audit records.
issue_request: FHIR-12367 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 by Patient Care. It requested CareTeam.context 0..1 Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare), CareTeam.reasonReference 0..* Reference(Condition), and CareTeam.reasonCode 0..* CodeableConcept because CareTeam could exist independently of CarePlan and needed its own encounter, episode, and condition context.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12367. Historical source imported in c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 shows GF#12367 annotations on CareTeam.encounter and on the separate CareTeam.reasonCode and CareTeam.reasonReference elements. Current StructureDefinition source keeps GF#12367 on CareTeam.reason, and source/fhir.ini maps the old reasonCode/reasonReference pair into reason.concept/reason.reference.
additional_context: FHIR-23029 later resolved to remove CareTeam.encounter and the EpisodeOfCare standard extension from CareTeam; FHIR-23843 added the inverse Encounter.careTeam 0..* Reference(CareTeam). The combined branch already contains audit commits for FHIR-23029 and FHIR-23843, so they were not republished. FHIR-44683 later clarified why EpisodeOfCare.careTeam may repeat. CareTeam remains an active Patient Care resource in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because CareTeam.reason is a 0..* CodeableReference targeting Condition, source/fhir.ini documents the old reason element migration, and current CareTeam context is conveyed through inbound Encounter.careTeam, EpisodeOfCare.careTeam, and CarePlan.careTeam references plus CareTeam narrative.

related_jiras.note: Superseded the CareTeam.context/encounter direction by resolving to remove CareTeam.encounter and the EpisodeOfCare extension from CareTeam; already audited on the combined branch.
Companion PA issue added Encounter.careTeam 0..* Reference(CareTeam) as the inverse relationship; already audited on the combined branch.
Clarified EpisodeOfCare.careTeam repetition and supports the current EpisodeOfCare-side relationship without requiring a FHIR-12367 source edit.
